fullPassage: Television is the number one leisure activity in the United States and Europe, consuming more than half of our free time. We generally think of television as a way to relax, tune out, and escape from our troubles for a bit each day. While this is true, there is increasing evidence that we are more motivated to tune in to our favorite shows and characters when we are feeling lonely or have a greater need for social connection. Television watching does satisfy these social needs to some extent, at least in the short run. Unfortunately, it is also likely to "crowd out" other activities that produce more sustainable social contributions to our social well-being. The more television we watch, the less likely we are to volunteer our time or to spend time with people in our social networks. In other words, the more time we make for Friends, the less time we have for friends in real life.

✅ ① (A) 달리다 — (B) 단기(간): (A)는 강가를 달리는 동작, (B)는 'in the short run(단기적으로)'을 뜻하므로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 운영하다 — (B) 단기: (A)의 run은 달리는 동작
❌ ③ (A) 달리다 — (B) 흐르다: (B)의 run은 흐름이 아닌 기간(단기)
❌ ④ (A) 출마하다 — (B) 달리다: 둘 다 틀림
det.tip: run: ① 달리다 ② in the short/long run(단기/장기적으로) ③ 운영하다 ④ 출마하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "time when you are free from work and can relax or do what you enjoy"

det.korean: leisure=여가 (일에서 벗어나 쉬거나 즐기는 시간)
det.analysis:
❌ ① evidence(증거): 사실의 근거로 정의와 무관
❌ ② connection(연결): 관계로 정의와 다름
❌ ③ extent(정도): 범위로 정의와 무관
✅ ④ leisure(여가): 일에서 자유로워 쉬거나 즐기는 시간으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: leisure = 여가. free from work and can relax가 핵심 단서

questions.passage: Television is the number one leisure activity in the United States and Europe, __________ (consumption) more than half of our free time. We generally think of it as a way to relax.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 분사구문을 이루는 현재분사 consuming (명사 consumption → 현재분사 consuming)
det.analysis: 'Television is ... activity ..., __________ more than half of our free time'에서 주절을 부연 설명하는 분사구문이 필요하다. 명사 consumption(소비)을 동사 consume의 현재분사 consuming으로 바꾼다. consumption → consuming
det.tip: 분사구문: ..., consuming more than half of our free time(자유 시간의 절반을 소비하면서)

questions.passage: There is increasing evidence that we are more __________ (motivation) to tune in to our favorite shows when we are feeling lonely. Television watching does satisfy these social needs to some extent, at least in the short run.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: be동사 + 과거분사 motivated: 수동 의미 '동기부여되다'
det.analysis: 'we are more __________ to tune in'에서 be동사 are 뒤에 수동 의미를 나타내는 과거분사가 필요하다. 명사 motivation(동기)을 동사 motivate의 과거분사 motivated로 바꾼다. motivation → motivated
det.tip: be motivated to V = ~하도록 동기부여되다/~하고 싶어지다

questions.passage: Television is the number one leisure activity in the United States and Europe, consuming more than half of our free time. We generally think of television as a way to relax, tune out, and __________ each day. While this is true, there is increasing evidence that we are more motivated to tune in to our favorite shows and characters when we are feeling lonely or have a greater need for social connection. Television watching does satisfy these social needs to some extent, at least in the short run. Unfortunately, it is also likely to "crowd out" other activities that produce more sustainable social contributions to our social well-being. The more television we watch, the less likely we are to volunteer our time or to spend time with people in our social networks. In other words, the more time we make for Friends, the less time we have for friends in real life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: escape from our troubles for a bit=잠시 걱정에서 벗어나다 — 사람들이 텔레비전을 보는 일반적 이유
det.analysis:
❌ ① earn some extra money every single day(매일 돈을 번다): 본문과 무관
✅ ② escape from our troubles for a bit(잠시 걱정에서 벗어나다): 긴장을 풀고 걱정에서 벗어나는 방법으로 텔레비전을 본다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ meet brand-new people in person daily(매일 새 사람을 직접 만난다): 텔레비전 시청과 반대
❌ ④ improve our physical health very quickly(건강을 빨리 향상시킨다): 본문과 무관
det.tip: a way to relax, tune out, and escape from our troubles for a bit

ch: earn some extra money every single day
escape from our troubles for a bit
meet brand-new people in person daily
improve our physical health very quickly

questions.passage: Television is the number one leisure activity in the United States and Europe, consuming more than half of our free time. We generally think of television as a way to relax, tune out, and escape from our troubles for a bit each day. While this is true, there is increasing evidence that we are more motivated to tune in to our favorite shows and characters when we are feeling lonely or have a greater need for social connection. Television watching does satisfy these social needs to some extent, at least in the short run. Unfortunately, it is also likely to "crowd out" other activities that produce more sustainable social contributions to our social well-being. The more television we watch, the less likely we are to volunteer our time or to __________. In other words, the more time we make for Friends, the less time we have for friends in real life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: spend time with people in our social networks=사회적 관계망의 사람들과 시간을 보내다 — 텔레비전을 많이 볼수록 줄어드는 것
det.analysis:
❌ ① watch even more of our favorite shows(프로그램을 더 많이 본다): 텔레비전 시청이 밀어내는 대상이 아님
❌ ② feel far more lonely and isolated(더 외롭고 고립된다): 줄어드는 '활동'이 아니라 감정
✅ ③ spend time with people in our social networks(관계망의 사람들과 시간을 보낸다): 텔레비전을 많이 볼수록 자원봉사나 사람들과 보내는 시간이 줄어든다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ escape completely from all our troubles(걱정에서 완전히 벗어난다): 본문의 밀려나는 활동과 무관
det.tip: the less likely we are to volunteer our time or to spend time with people in our social networks

ch: watch even more of our favorite shows
feel far more lonely and isolated
spend time with people in our social networks
escape completely from all our troubles
